lines.text: Hi! I am outside the cube. I will tell you what I see. Short words work best.
Hi! I am inside the cube. I will tell you what I see. Short words work best.
It worked!
We did it!
Sorry, I did not get that. Short words work best: go, wait, yes, no.
Okay, waiting. Say go when you are ready.
I can barely hear you. Tell me your face, like: face 3.
I cannot hear you at all. I am coming around to your side.
There is more to solve. Lead the way, I will follow.
I do not know this puzzle yet. I will stay close and keep my hands off.
Everything is solved. Heading to the portal.
The portal is awake. Stepping in.
Oh. It is you. I am outside the cube. Keep your messages short.
Oh. It is you. I am inside the cube. Keep your messages short.
It worked. I knew it would.
We did it. I mean, I did most of it.
What? Use short words: go, wait, yes, no. Honestly.
Fine, I am waiting. Say go. Not that I mind.
No idea what this one is. I am not touching it. You figure it out.
All solved. To the portal. Do not make me wait.
The portal is awake. I am going in. Keep up.
Hi! Can you hear me?
Hello? Is anyone there?
Okay. I am here.
Give me a sec...
Got it.
Okay, on it.
Over here!
I found something.
I can't hear you. Come closer.
You are very quiet. Are you far away?
I can hear you again.
Wrong way, I think.
Wait. Let me look around.
What do you see?
Can you describe it?
Which side is it on for you?
I don't see that on my side.
Nothing here. Just a wall.
I am not sure. Sorry.
Oops. My mistake.
Nice one!
Thank you!
Tell me when you are through.
Stay there. Don't move.
I am going to the next face.
Everything is solved. Let's go to the portal.
I can see a plate on my floor. Standing on it now.
I am on the plate. Tell me when you are through.
The door just opened! Going for the crystal.
A sealed door, a crystal behind it. Is there a switch on your side?
Everything is solved. Heading to the portal on face 6.
Nothing else I can do from here. What do you see?
Oh. It's you. Can you even hear me?
Fine. I am here.
Ugh. Give me a second.
Got it. Obviously.
Fine, I will do it.
Over here. Try to keep up.
I found something. You're welcome.
I can't hear you. Not that I care.
Speak up. You are too far away.
Oh, you are back. Whatever.
Wrong way. Honestly.
Hold on. I am looking.
So? What do you see?
Describe it properly.
My left, not yours.
There is nothing like that on my side.
Just a wall. Thrilling.
I don't know. Don't look at me like that.
That was not my fault.
Not bad. For you.
It's not like I did it for you.
Hurry up, I am not waiting forever.
Don't move. I mean it.
I am going to the next face. Don't get lost.
All solved. Portal. Now.
Ugh, a plate on my floor. Fine, I will stand on it.
I am on the plate. Hurry up, I am not doing this for you.
The door opened. I am getting the crystal, obviously.
A sealed door and a crystal. Find the switch on your side already.
All solved. Portal, face 6. Do not make me wait.
Nothing to do over here. So? What do you see?
